content: Root cause: The original implementation of the `mcp251x_hw_reset()` function did not allow sufficient time for the MCP251x CAN controller to complete its reset process, particularly on certain boards that require more than the hardcoded 5ms delay. This led to a situation where the function would prematurely check the status of the controller, resulting in a failure to enter the configuration mode, which was indicated by the return value of -ENODEV. The patch addresses this by introducing a retry mechanism that allows for additional time and attempts to check the status after the reset, thus accommodating boards with longer power-up times.
